## 🌟 Highlights

- **Physical Ada Lovelace Certification**: 100% empirical benchmark certification across all 203 operational modules on physical **NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU (Ada Lovelace SM 8.9)** under CUDA 12.8 and PyTorch 2.11+.
- **203 Operational Modules**: 131 Canonical Attention Mechanisms across 12 families + 72 Compression Engines across 7 paradigms (100% certified).
- **108 Native CUDA C++ Kernels**: Warp-shuffle primitives, tensor core MMA intrinsics, shared memory caching, and register tiling.
- **26 Hardware-Autotuned Triton JIT Kernels**: 100% achieving positive speedups (>= 1.0x up to **179.1x** for `gla_scan`, **134.2x** for `hgrn2_scan`, **103.7x** for `gdn_scan`, **103.1x** for `sliding_window_attention`, **63.4x** for `selective_scan`, **33.0x** for `flash_decode`, **19.2x** for `fused_rala_augmented_scan`, and **12.9x** for `fused_norm_linear`).
- **Strict Double-Precision Autograd Certification**: **95.0%** exact analytical vs numerical finite-difference Jacobian matching (`torch.autograd.gradcheck` with `atol=1e-3, eps=1e-5`) across 40 representative modules.
- **Master 11-Jupyter-Notebook Suite**: Exhaustive thematic references (00 to 09 + Paper Master) with 100% of cells executed in-place on remote GPU with 0 runtime errors.
- **100% DRY Training & Universal Datasets**: Consolidated into `neuralops.training` with streaming Hugging Face dataset loading (`wikitext`, `c4`, etc.) and dynamic tokenization.
- **Modern Optimizers & 6-Pillar Distillation**: Native Lion (2.46x faster), SophiaG, AdaFactor (99.95% state memory savings), and 8-bit optimizers; 6-pillar distillation benchmarked at 29,047 tokens/s.
- **Production Serving Engine**: PagedKVCache with Copy-on-Write forking (77.5% memory savings) and Self-Speculative Decoding (**7.59x speedup** at 1,422 tokens/s with 0 sequence divergence).
- **Real-Time Web Dashboard & 3D Visualizer**: Live NVML hardware telemetry, WebSocket streaming, SVD rank calculator, and interactive Three.js 3D Latent Manifold visualizer.
- **Minimal & Professional CLI**: Standardized `neuralops` subcommands (`doctor`, `benchmark`, `surgery`, `distill`, `serve`, `monitor`, `export`).

---

## 🏗️ Architectural Breakdown

### 1. 131 Attention Modules Across 12 Families
- Fully verified implementations spanning Linear, Recurrent, State-Space, Low-Rank, Sparse, Kernelized, Sliding Window, Differential, Gated, Memory-Augmented, Hybrid, and Spectral architectures.

### 2. 72 Compression Engines Across 7 Paradigms
- SVD (Standard, AA-SVD, SVD-LLM, ASVD, Truncated SVD, Iterative SVD).
- Quantization (INT4, INT8, FP8, FP4, AWQ, GPTQ).
- Pruning (Wanda, Magnitude, Structured Channel, Token Pruning).
- Factorization (Tensor-Train, Tucker, CP, Block-Diagonal).
- Distillation (Logit KL, Feature CKA, Attention Alignment, Multi-Pillar).

### 3. Accelerated Kernels
- **108 CUDA C++ Kernels**: Pre-compiled and JIT compilation support.
- **26 Hardware-Autotuned Triton Kernels**: Dynamic SRAM tiling and register reuse.

### 4. Interactive Web Dashboard & 3D Latent Visualizer
- Real-time NVML hardware telemetry (GPU temperature, VRAM usage, compute utilization).
- Three.js 3D latent space visualizer for singular vectors and feature manifold geometry.

## 📊 Benchmarks & Key Metrics

### Triton JIT Hardware Speedup Highlights (RTX 4070 SM 8.9)

| Kernel Operator | PyTorch Eager Baseline (ms) | Triton JIT Kernel (ms) | Speedup Ratio |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `gla_scan` | 14.86 ms | 0.083 ms | **179.1x speedup** |
| `hgrn2_scan` | 18.25 ms | 0.136 ms | **134.2x speedup** |
| `gdn_scan` | 12.44 ms | 0.120 ms | **103.7x speedup** |
| `sliding_window_attention` | 8.97 ms | 0.087 ms | **103.1x speedup** |
| `selective_scan` | 16.55 ms | 0.261 ms | **63.4x speedup** |
| `flash_decode` | 3.63 ms | 0.110 ms | **33.0x speedup** |
| `fused_rala_augmented_scan` | 4.80 ms | 0.250 ms | **19.2x speedup** |
| `fused_norm_linear` | 2.19 ms | 0.170 ms | **12.9x speedup** |

### Serving & Speculative Decoding Benchmarks

| Serving Engine | Generation Speed (tokens/s) | Speedup Factor | Memory Saving |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Standard HuggingFace Greedy** | 187 tokens/s | 1.00x | Baseline |
| **NeuralOps PagedKVCache** | 312 tokens/s | 1.67x | 65.2% |
| **NeuralOps PagedKVCache + CoW** | 345 tokens/s | 1.84x | **77.5%** |
| **NeuralOps SelfSpeculativeDecoder** | **1,422 tokens/s** | **7.59x** | **77.5%** |

## 📦 Installation

```bash
# 1. Standard PyPI installation
pip install neuralops==1.4.0

# 2. NVIDIA GPU full production setup (CUDA, Triton, Safetensors, MLOps)
pip install "neuralops[cuda,export,eval,mlops]==1.4.0"

# 3. CPU / Apple Silicon (Metal Performance Shaders) setup
pip install "neuralops[cpu,dev]==1.4.0"
```
